mapper.sql: select m.id, m.record_id, m.weather_code, m.weather_name, m.sky_type, m.cloud_density, m.rain_intensity, m.lightning_intensity, m.wind_speed, m.fog_intensity, m.color_temperature, m.saturation, m.particle_style, m.animation_seed, m.extra_params, m.create_time, m.create_by, m.update_time, m.update_by, m.del_flag, m.remark, a.ai_summary, a.primary_emotion, a.secondary_emotion, a.scene_recognition, a.risk_level from biz_weather_mapping m left join biz_ai_analysis_result a on a.record_id = m.record_id and a.del_flag = 0
mapper.select: where m.record_id = ( select r.id from biz_mood_record r where r.user_id = #{userId} and date(r.record_time) = date(#{snapshotDate}) and r.del_flag = 0 order by r.record_time desc, r.id desc limit 1 ) and m.del_flag = 0 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into biz_weather_mapping ( record_id, weather_code, weather_name, sky_type, cloud_density, rain_intensity, lightning_intensity, wind_speed, fog_intensity, color_temperature, saturation, particle_style, animation_seed, extra_params, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, remark ) values ( #{recordId}, #{weatherCode}, #{weatherName}, #{skyType}, #{cloudDensity}, #{rainIntensity}, #{lightningIntensity}, #{windSpeed}, #{fogIntensity}, #{colorTemperature}, #{saturation}, #{particleStyle}, #{animationSeed}, #{extraParams}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{delFlag}, #{remark} ) on duplicate key update weather_code = values(weather_code), weather_name = values(weather_name), sky_type = values(sky_type), cloud_density = values(cloud_density), rain_intensity = values(rain_intensity), lightning_intensity = values(lightning_intensity), wind_speed = values(wind_speed), fog_intensity = values(fog_intensity), color_temperature = values(color_temperature), saturation = values(saturation), particle_style = values(particle_style), animation_seed = values(animation_seed), extra_params = values(extra_params), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = values(update_time), del_flag = 0, remark = values(remark)
